semiconductor_relevance: High — Hirasawa Precision is deeply involved in precision manufacturing and microfabrication technologies for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Hirasawa Precision Co., Ltd. is a key player in the semiconductor industry, specializing in precision manufacturing and advanced microfabrication technologies. The company operates facilities in Japan and Thailand, focusing on producing high-quality semiconductor components and equipment.

regional_presence.Japan: Operates multiple facilities focusing on semiconductor components and equipment.
regional_presence.Thailand: Hosts manufacturing facilities to support semiconductor production.
